articles.title: Dowry Death Shock in Prayagraj: Married Woman’s Body Found in Canal, Husband and In-Laws Booked
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The body of an unidentified young woman found in a canal in the Mauaima police station area of Prayagraj has been identified as Muskan Mishra (22). Following identification, police have registered a dowry death case against four members of her in-laws’ family, including her husband.

body.html:
The body of an unidentified young woman found in a canal in the Mauaima police station area of Prayagraj has been identified as Muskan Mishra (22). Following identification, police have registered a dowry death case against four members of her in-laws’ family, including her husband.

Muskan, a resident of Melha village under Baharia police station limits, was married on February 28, 2023, to Dheeraj Mishra of Barhada village in Pratapgarh district. Her parents identified her body after seeing photographs circulated on social media.

Muskan’s brother, Sunil Mishra, alleged that she was continuously harassed for dowry after marriage. Based on his complaint, police have named husband Dheeraj Mishra, father-in-law Pushkar Mishra, brother-in-law Neeraj Mishra and sister-in-law Riya Mishra, accusing them of killing Muskan and dumping her body in the canal.

According to Sunil, he received a call from Muskan’s in-laws on the evening of February 5 claiming she was missing. Her mobile phone was switched off after 10 pm the same night. Earlier, the in-laws had lodged a missing complaint, alleging that Muskan had left the house with jewellery.

On Friday morning, Muskan’s body was found on the Sharda Sahayak Canal track near Bhawanigarh Tilai Bazaar, causing panic in the area. After identification, Mauaima police registered a case and detained the father-in-law and brother-in-law for questioning.

A videographed post-mortem conducted by a panel of doctors on Saturday indicated death by hanging. Apart from a ligature mark on the neck, no other injuries were found. Police said the death likely occurred on the night of February 5. Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Man in Burqa Enters Ladies Coach, Tries to Molest Women on Mumbai Local, Flees
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident was reported on a Mumbai local train after a man allegedly entered a ladies’ reserved compartment wearing a burqa and attempted to inappropriately touch women passengers. The incident took place on a Central Railway fast local bound for CSMT on Friday afternoon.

body.html:
A shocking incident was reported on a Mumbai local train after a man allegedly entered a ladies’ reserved compartment wearing a burqa and attempted to inappropriately touch women passengers. The incident took place on a Central Railway fast local bound for CSMT on Friday afternoon.

According to police, women commuters in the second-class ladies’ coach grew suspicious of a co-passenger in a burqa. When confronted, they discovered the person was a man and questioned him for travelling in the ladies’ compartment. Some women began recording the incident on their mobile phones.

The women warned that he would be handed over to the police at Ghatkopar station. However, before the train halted, the accused jumped off the train onto the tracks and fled towards another platform, where he boarded a Karjat-bound local.

The women later complained to on-duty police personnel at Ghatkopar station. CCTV footage was checked, but the accused was not clearly captured. Police also checked the Karjat-bound train at Mulund, but the man had already alighted.

After the video went viral on social media, the Railway Protection Force (RPF) registered an FIR under the Indian Railway Act for unauthorised travel in a ladies’ coach. A search is on to trace the accused.

articles.title: Lunch Turns Fatal: Container Truck Crashes Into House, Man Killed in Gujarat’s Valsad
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A man was killed on the spot in Gujarat’s Valsad district on Friday after a container truck lost balance and crashed into his house while he was about to sit down for lunch. The accident occurred around 1 pm on National Highway-48 in the Pardi area.

body.html:
A man was killed on the spot in Gujarat’s Valsad district on Friday after a container truck lost balance and crashed into his house while he was about to sit down for lunch.

The accident occurred around 1 pm on National Highway-48 in the Pardi area. According to police, a car attempting to overtake allegedly caused the container truck to lose control and overturn, crashing into a nearby residential house close to the Pardi Mamlatdar office.

The entire incident was captured on CCTV. In one clip, the container truck is seen passing by a window as the man carries on with his routine. Moments later, the truck veers off the road and ploughs into the house, crushing a room and killing the man instantly.

Pardi police rushed to the spot after receiving information and began an investigation. Rescue and removal operations were carried out using a crane to clear the overturned container.

The accident caused a massive traffic jam on the Mumbai–Ahmedabad National Highway, leading to inconvenience for commuters. Police restored traffic flow.

articles.title: Surajkund Mela Tragedy: Police Inspector Killed, 13 Injured in Swing Collapse | Faridabad News
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic accident at the 2026 Surajkund International Crafts Mela in Faridabad has claimed the life of Inspector Jagdish Prasad. The 'Tsunami' swing snapped mid-air with 15 people on board. Watch for the latest updates on the probe and rescue operations.

body.html:
A tragic accident at the 2026 Surajkund International Crafts Mela in Faridabad has claimed the life of Inspector Jagdish Prasad. The 'Tsunami' swing snapped mid-air with 15 people on board. Watch for the latest updates on the probe and rescue operations.

***

An on-duty police inspector was killed and at least 13 people were injured after a giant Tsunami swing snapped mid-air and crashed at the Surajkund International Crafts Mela in Faridabad on Saturday evening.

The incident occurred around 6:15 pm when nearly 15 people were riding the swing. Police said the structure tilted suddenly before collapsing onto the ground, triggering panic at the crowded fair.

The deceased has been identified as Inspector Jagdish Prasad of Palwal Police, who was deployed on fair duty. He was rushed to hospital but was declared dead on arrival. Officials said the officer showed bravery and attempted to save people, but suffered severe head and facial injuries. He was due to retire in March.

Following the accident, the mela ground was evacuated. District Magistrate Ayush Sinha supervised rescue operations, and the injured were shifted to hospitals.

A probe has been ordered into the incident. Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Saini expressed grief over the death and assured proper treatment for the injured. The Surajkund Mela, inaugurated on January 31, is scheduled to continue till February 15.

articles.title: Homework Horror in UP: Class 2 Student Beaten 105 Times by Teacher in Gonda
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of corporal punishment has emerged from Gonda district, Uttar Pradesh, where a Class 2 student was allegedly beaten 105 times with a stick by his teacher for not completing homework.

body.html:
A shocking case of corporal punishment has emerged from Gonda district, Uttar Pradesh, where a Class 2 student was allegedly beaten 105 times with a stick by his teacher for not completing homework.

The incident took place on Wednesday at MRG Public School in Gumdaha, under the Colonelganj police station area. The accused teacher, Prakhar Singh (38), allegedly assaulted 10-year-old Abhishek during a Social Science class after finding his homework incomplete. Other students were left terrified as the child cried in pain.

According to the complaint, the teacher later gave the child a biscuit and threatened him with further beatings if he informed his family. After returning home in tears, the child narrated the incident to his father, Raj Prasad Goswami, who took him to hospital for first aid.

When the father approached the school to complain, he alleged that the principal scolded him and sent him away. Later the same evening, he filed a complaint at the police station. An FIR has been registered against the teacher, and the child’s medical examination was conducted on Friday.

Police said an investigation is underway. The school management has removed the accused teacher, stating that such incidents will not be tolerated.

articles.title: House Collapses on Poclain During Encroachment Drive in Banda, Driver Buried Alive
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major accident occurred on Friday during an anti-encroachment drive at the Baberu main intersection in Banda district, Uttar Pradesh, when a three-storey house collapsed onto a Poclain machine, trapping the driver under debris.

body.html:
A major accident occurred on Friday during an anti-encroachment drive at the Baberu main intersection in Banda district, Uttar Pradesh, when a three-storey house collapsed onto a Poclain machine, trapping the driver under debris.

The incident took place around 2 pm in the Baberu Kotwali area, where the administration was carrying out demolition as part of a road widening and beautification project. The house, owned by Devendra Kasodhan, was being demolished when a large portion suddenly collapsed on the machine.

The Poclain driver, Dilip Kumar (28), was buried under the rubble, triggering panic at the site. Two bulldozers were deployed, and after nearly 30 minutes of rescue efforts, the injured driver was pulled out and rushed to the hospital. His condition is reported to be stable. The machine was also damaged in the accident.

Senior officials, including CO Saurabh Singh and the Deputy District Magistrate, reached the spot and supervised the rescue operation. The administration said an investigation is underway.

The incident sparked anger among local traders, who alleged negligence by the tehsil administration and the PWD, claiming adequate safety measures were not followed during the demolition.

SDM Avneesh Tyagi stated that maintaining law and order was the administration’s responsibility, while demolition work was handled by the contractor.

articles.title: Bike Demand Turns Fatal: Son Beats Vegetable Vendor Father to Death in Medak
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident from Telangana’s Medak district, a man was allegedly beaten to death by his son following a dispute over buying a motorcycle. The victim, Shakir (51), was a vegetable vendor residing in Regode mandal.

body.html:
In a shocking incident from Telangana’s Medak district, a man was allegedly beaten to death by his son following a dispute over buying a motorcycle.

The victim, Shakir (51), was a vegetable vendor residing in Regode mandal. Police said his son, Mohammad Hussain, had been pressuring his parents for some time to buy him a bike and sell land to give him money.

About a month ago, Hussain had allegedly assaulted his father over the issue, after which village elders intervened and brokered a compromise. However, tensions reportedly continued within the family.

On Saturday night, the accused allegedly dragged his father out of the house while he was asleep and assaulted him brutally. Shakir sustained severe injuries and died on the spot.

Police reached the scene after receiving information and registered a case based on a complaint filed by the deceased’s wife. An investigation is underway.

articles.title: Midnight Hostel Exit Caught on CCTV: Suryapet School Faces Safety questions After Viral Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An incident involving a residential school hostel in Telangana’s Suryapet district has sparked serious concerns over student safety after CCTV footage went viral on social media.

body.html:
An incident involving a residential school hostel in Telangana’s Suryapet district has sparked serious concerns over student safety after CCTV footage went viral on social media.

The footage allegedly shows two girl students leaving the hostel around midnight with boys on motorcycles and returning early the next morning. The incident, reportedly captured on the hostel’s CCTV cameras, has raised questions about security arrangements and supervision at the residential school.

Parents and social media users have expressed concern over how students were able to cross the hostel gate unnoticed at night. Many questioned the role of hostel wardens, watchmen and gate control systems, stating that CCTV footage is useful only after incidents occur, while strict monitoring is needed to prevent them.

The incident has reignited debate on hostel safety, student discipline and management accountability. Experts say hostel authorities have a responsibility to ensure proper night supervision, controlled entry and exit, and regular checks to safeguard students.

At the same time, the incident has also highlighted the need for awareness and responsibility among students, stressing that trust placed by parents should not be misused.

No official statement has been issued yet by the school management regarding the viral video.

articles.title: Road Rage Horror in Bengaluru: Biker Blocks Car, Smashes Mirror at Madavara Junction
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Another alarming case of road rage has been reported in Bengaluru, raising concerns over growing aggression on city roads. The incident occurred at Madavara Junction, where a minor traffic dispute escalated into a violent confrontation.

body.html:
Another alarming case of road rage has been reported in Bengaluru, raising concerns over growing aggression on city roads. The incident occurred at Madavara Junction, where a minor traffic dispute escalated into a violent confrontation.

According to police and visuals shared online, a biker allegedly blocked a car, abused and threatened the driver, made obscene gestures, and damaged the vehicle by breaking its side-view mirror. The biker was also seen kicking the car before fleeing the spot.

The car driver, identified as Aditya, was travelling from Nelamangala to Manyata Tech Park when the incident took place. The entire episode was captured on camera and has since gone viral on social media, triggering public outrage.

Madanayakanahalli police said a case has been registered and an investigation is underway. Police have also sought public assistance to identify the biker and urged witnesses to come forward with information.

The incident has once again highlighted the rising instances of road rage in Bengaluru, prompting calls for strict action to ensure road safety.

articles.title: Married Thrice Despite Dowry Case: Groom Arrested Mid-Wedding in Sitapur Guest House
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of dowry harassment and marital fraud has surfaced in the Maholi police station area of Sitapur, where a man was caught while attempting his third marriage despite a dowry harassment case filed by his second wife being pending in court.

body.html:
A shocking case of dowry harassment and marital fraud has surfaced in the Maholi police station area of Sitapur, where a man was caught while attempting his third marriage despite a dowry harassment case filed by his second wife being pending in court.

The accused, Vipin, a resident of Maholi, was first married to Neetu of Hardoi. He later married Anupam from Hirapur Ganj in Sitapur’s Machrehta area. Anupam alleged that soon after the wedding, she was harassed for an additional dowry of ₹4 lakh and subjected to mental and physical abuse. She returned to her parental home within ten days. A case related to dowry harassment and molestation has been pending since 2021.

On February 5, Anupam received information that Vipin was preparing for his third marriage at Sanskar Guest House in Maholi. Acting on her complaint, police conducted a raid and found the accused performing wedding rituals. He was detained on the spot and taken to Machrehta police station.

The victim alleged that the accused was openly violating the law despite the ongoing court case. Police said no fresh written complaint has been received yet and further action will be taken once it is submitted.
